Hi Emily — great meeting, thanks for the clear asks. Below is a concise eval plan we can run on Redwood (I attached the prompt set example and a short playbook):

High-level plan
- We’ll spin a temporary eval project scoped to RDW-3456 and run the benchmarks on your provided dataset (we can run in our hosted environment or in your VPC — recommend hosted for speed).
- Timeline: ingest + quick smoke tests (1 day), quality sweep across 3 model variants (2 days), final report + replayable eval notebook (1 day). Total ~4 business days once we have the dataset.

Recommended models to test (suggested sweep)
- redwood-rlhf-13b (low latency; baseline accuracy)
- redwood-llama-70b-q4f (high-quality, quantized perf)
- redwood-mix-30b (balanced cost/quality)
Notes: if latency is critical we can include a distilled 7B variant; if compliance/PII handling matters we can run a dedicated private deployment with KMS key isolation.

Dataset format & example
- Preferred: JSONL where each record is a flat JSON with keys: id, input_text, context (optional), label(s), metadata. For summarization provide: id, transcript_text, reference_summary. For classification: id, message_text, intent_label.
- Example attached: fincoc_eval_promptset.jsonl (100 records sample).

Scoring criteria & thresholds (suggested)
- Classification (triage): macro-F1 with per-class F1 >= 0.78 and overall accuracy >= 82%.
- Generation (summarization): ROUGE-1 >= 0.55 and a human-rated relevance score avg >= 4/5 on a 50-sample spot check.
- Regression checks: we’ll compare against your baseline model (please indicate baseline id). We’ll flag any >5% drop in F1 or >0.06 ROUGE reduction as a quality regression requiring follow-up.

Privacy & compliance
- Hosted eval: Redwood will access the dataset in a short-lived eval environment; we recommend S3 presigned upload to our ingestion bucket or a shared Drive link. Data retention: by default we retain artifacts for 7 days unless you request deletion.
- If you need KMS/HSM isolation or air-gapped run we can schedule Private eval (adds 1-2 days to provisioning). Please let us know SOC2/document request items; Vivek (cc) will handle evidence.

Next steps / action items
- Emily: confirm baseline model id and whether you prefer hosted vs VPC eval.
- FinCo Data Ops: upload sample datasets to the Drive folder (link below) or provide S3 presigned URL; include a README with field mapping.
- Redwood (Neha/Marissa): will create the eval project and share the run dashboard + notebook link once started.

Attachments: fincoc_eval_promptset.jsonl (sample), redwood_eval_playbook.pdf (playbook with dataset schema + scoring scripts)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b_example_eval_assets
Redwood eval console (internal): https://app.redwood.ai/evals/RDW-3456

Thanks — we’ll prioritize once we have the sample.

Best,
